newsitem.title: FRANCE: Schneider shares fall, profits disappoint.
newsitem.headline: Schneider shares fall, profits disappoint.

text.p: Shares in French electrical engineering group Schneider were down sharply but off their lows in early trade on Thursday after release of first-half figures showing a 26.7 percent profit jump.
At 0822 GMT, the shares were off 2.44 percent or 6.0 francs at 240.0 francs. But that was above their low of 234.5 francs touched soon after the results.

"The results were below what the market was looking for," said one trader. "You're seeing some disappointment," said another. "People had got hopes up before the results. The 503 million (francs net income) was really the bottom of the (forecast) range."
Schneider reported first-half net attributable profit of 503 million francs versus 397 million francs for the corresponding year-earlier period.
